reviews.title: Great nvme drive no problems
reviews.comment: No problems so far, runs faster than any previous drives I have had, and everythings working nice and smooth on this new pc build. I have nothing to complain about, and it has lots of space for my linux bazzite operating system and any big games I want to install. I'm happy I was able to get this drive, it works perfectly fine, fast, and was way cheaper than the other ones available. Sadly a month later end of February 2026 I see the price has gone up a hundred bucks to like 430, still about the best price now since everything else is up but dang...ram apocalypse. Glad I got it just before it went up.
reviews.author: John C.

reviews.title: Pretty accurate and impressive
reviews.comment: 101% Honest Review -------------- I was a little nervous about going with KingSpec over a bigger name brand for a 4TB drive, but I’m glad I took the risk. It may seem like overkill, but it's been running flawlessly for a while now, and the speeds are every bit as fast as advertised. Having this much space at this price point is a total lifesaver for my gaming library. I question the durability in the long run, but so far so good. This thing is fast, has exceptional storage, and is going strong. I definitely recommend it.
reviews.author: Aiden Gar.

reviews.title: Read/Write+
reviews.comment: After running low on my D: drive on my gaming computer, I found myself in the market for a new faster and larger (more storage) SSD. I was looking for something that had increased capabilities but yet was less in cost than WD, Samsung, and Seagate. Now I did this upgrade right around the same time I upgraded my C: drive SSD too. However, that was a different brand I used for that drive. This Kingspec is the second one to date that I have purchased. The first was a 2230 which was meant for an upgrade to a console but ended up never doing the upgraded so it has been used as additional storage on another console (works great and greatly reduced load speeds). After reading the good experience with the 2230 I figured I would give them another go ahead. This specific ssd replaced a Crucial P5+ which worked flawlessly, however I was looking to get more storage and while I'm doing that why not look to improve read/write speeds too?! I've never heard anyone say I don't like my computer to boot, or load programs/games faster. The storage on the Kingspec doubled my Crucial which is now a few years old and it also it also reads and writes faster than my Crucial did too. I have ran crystal disk to evaluate the speeds and I have peaked at 7200/6500 r/w which is faster than what my crucial was capable of. So far I am pleased with the performance of the Kingspec.
reviews.author: SM
